purpose: This blueprint defines the source-level adoption contract and does not itself contain vendored production source.

source_policy.role: Semantic/privacy policy layered over source-scope reachability. It can require mandatory surgery even when a file remains REQUIRED_VENDOR or REQUIRED_TRANSITIVE.
source_policy.precedence: EXCLUDED, DEFERRED_NOT_VENDORED, and source-policy constraints take precedence over KEEP_AS_IS.
source_policy.private_reasoning: Raw model-private reasoning must never cross the product boundary. Pure private-reasoning extractor/renderer files are excluded; mechanics-bearing dependencies listed by source-policy require surgery before they can be vendored.

preserve_mechanics: Disclosure interaction mechanics without model-private reasoning semantics

source_vendor_seam: LLM setup gate -> disabled or replaced outside the vendored product-mechanics layer

domain_integration_boundary.research_adapter_layer: Research Adapter + Domain/ViewModel/Command + Xingwen Runtime replacement.
domain_integration_boundary.workspace_integration_layer: Product wiring (conversation-tabs defs -> Research tabs; canvas-ui tool -> Research drive-panel; Artifact Workspace).

reasoning_boundary.reasoning_trace_vs_private: ReasoningTrace is a public derivation record (Evidence-linked, versionable, auditable, explicit, user-safe). It is NOT model chain-of-thought.

hard_rules: When an approved OpenHands source-scope mechanic exists, preserve/vendor that upstream implementation rather than locally reimplementing it; EXCLUDED, DEFERRED_NOT_VENDORED, and source-policy constraints take precedence.
Research content replacement via Adapter/ViewModel, NOT second shell.
Visual adjustment = token/font/icon/density/coding-removal, NOT DOM/interaction rebuild.
Component unsuitable -> modify the approved upstream-derived component or resolve it through source-policy/surgical analysis, NOT a parallel local component.
Cannot surgically adapt an approved product mechanic -> STOP / request architecture ruling. NEVER build a second product skeleton.
Private model reasoning must never cross the product boundary; preserve only disclosure mechanics for explicit public/auditable reasoning.

source_vendor_completion_contract.requirement: At source-vendor completion, every initial REQUIRED_VENDOR / REQUIRED_TRANSITIVE / PARTIAL_SURGICAL scope entry must receive an explicit disposition.

provenance_contract: provenance.json: disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 equality, plus provenance -> approved source-scope membership and source-policy compliance, with strict per-entry repository/tag/commit/path/class/hash validation. Structural provenance does not assert full source-scope adoption closure.
